correctness.rationale: Exact elimination of the printed terminating-decimal matrix gives \(t+B\sin t=0\) with \(B=231898/2735\), and the remaining coordinates are fixed rational multiples of \(x_2\). The rational bounds \(26\pi<B<27\pi\) confine positive roots to 13 negative-sine lobes; strict convexity plus a negative midpoint gives exactly two roots per lobe, hence 53 equilibria including reflections and the origin. Independent numerical bracketing reproduced the 26 positive roots only as a check. The exact characteristic polynomial and Routh first-column thresholds, together with \(|\cos t|>1/4\), give 13 positive roots of each index; reflection doubles them and the origin adds one index-one point, yielding 26 index-two and 27 index-one hyperbolic equilibria.

originality.rationale: The open-access Ye--He article was inspected at its system construction, equilibrium analysis, and conclusions. It states that the controlled system has multiple/many unstable equilibrium points and lists sample nonzero equilibria, but it does not state the total count at \(\varepsilon_2=3.3,\sigma_2=4.7\) or the unstable-index split. The audited reduction to one scalar sine equation and exact convex-lobe/Routh classification therefore provides a complete same-parameter result not found in the inspected source or fresh Resultary search.
residual_risks: The theorem is specific to the paper's principal numerical amplitude/frequency pair; changing either controller parameter changes the root count.
The older sine-scroll literature could contain analogous counting techniques, but it concerns different vector fields and no checked source yielded this exact scalar equation or census.
